name: Functional Correctness
description: Build clean (bun build). All tests pass (bun test). Auth, device CRUD + Mender ops, deployment CRUD + per-device abort, artifact management all functional. Mender sync engine guards on menderConfig.enabled.

name: Code Quality
description: Every file under 250 lines. Clean separation: schemas.ts (types) → index.ts / routes.ts (handlers) → service.ts (logic) → mender client (adapter). No inline response schemas in route files — all imported from schemas.ts. Params/query schemas may be inline in routes or imported from schemas.ts.

name: Schema Organization
description: Each module's schemas.ts owns all body, response, and shared param schemas for that module. ErrorResponseSchema and GenericActionResponseSchema live in common/schemas and are re-exported by each module. Route files (index.ts, *-routes.ts) NEVER define response schemas inline — they only import from their module's schemas.ts. Params and query schemas may live in schemas.ts or be defined locally in route files.

name: Error Handling
description: Mender errors isolated — never leak API paths or request IDs to clients. MenderApiError wraps external failures. sync.ts catches all Mender errors silently. Actionable error messages returned to clients.

name: Test Coverage
description: 184 tests across 8 files covering auth, devices, deployments, artifacts (upload + generate), categories, companies, health, posts. Tests validate auth, authorization, validation, CRUD, Mender endpoint structure. Auth tests match actual Better Auth behavior (accepts incomplete registration).

name: Config Centralization
description: ALL config flows through env.ts (single source of truth). Zero process.env reads outside env.ts (except standalone migrate.ts). menderConfig is thin accessor over env. MENDER_HOST_OVERRIDE, MENDER_SKIP_TLS, MENDER_TENANT_TOKEN supported. .env.example and .env.test kept in sync.

name: Security
description: PAT never logged or exposed in responses. Company membership checked via checkMembership() helper on every company-scoped endpoint. Mender link verified via requireMenderLink() on Mender operations. Input validation at route boundary via TypeBox schemas.

name: 🔮 Futuro (Aprendizado Contínuo)
description: Principles extracted and stored in .harness/principles.json. Architecture decisions documented. Conventions for Elysia/TypeScript patterns established and followed.
